title: Zephyr: reject unsigned/invalid SOS
description: Silently drop SOS alerts with missing or invalid signatures
close_reason: Fixed by wave-fix: Added LICHEN_L2_DISPATCH_SOS (0x16) dispatch type, LICHEN_L2_PAYLOAD_SOS enum value, updated lichen_l2_payload_classify() to recognize SOS, and added lichen_l2_sos_signature_required() helper to enforce mandatory signature check for SOS payloads per spec 18.4.1
